jobs.title: Frontend Developer - React/TypeScript
jobs.shortDescription: Join our product team as a Frontend Developer building fast, accessible web interfaces with React and TypeScript.
jobs.fullDescription:
Responsibilities:
- Build React/TypeScript web interfaces that are fast and accessible
- Collaborate with designers on pixel-perfect implementations
- Own features from design handoff to production deployment
- Write maintainable, well-tested frontend code

Requirements:
- At least 2 years of professional React experience
- Strong TypeScript proficiency
- Experience with state management (Redux or Zustand)
- Familiarity with RESTful API integration
- Good understanding of responsive design and accessibility
jobs.educationLevel: Bachelor's in Computer Science or related field

jobs.title: Data Analyst / Business Intelligence
jobs.shortDescription: We are seeking a Data Analyst to turn raw data into actionable insights through dashboards and reports.
jobs.fullDescription:
Responsibilities:
- Design dashboards and run ad-hoc analyses
- Build automated reports and collaborate with product teams
- Drive data-informed decisions across the organisation

Requirements:
- Proficient in SQL — complex queries, CTEs, window functions
- Experience with Python or R for data manipulation
- Hands-on Tableau, Power BI, or Metabase experience
- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
jobs.educationLevel: Bachelor's in Statistics, Mathematics, or CS

jobs.title: Product Manager - Mobile Apps
jobs.shortDescription: Lead product strategy and execution for our flagship mobile application with ownership of the product roadmap.
jobs.fullDescription:
Responsibilities:
- Own the product roadmap for our mobile application
- Gather user feedback and prioritise features with engineering
- Drive key product metrics from concept through launch

Requirements:
- Minimum 3 years of product management experience
- Proven track record shipping mobile products on iOS and Android
- Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
- Strong data-driven decision making with SQL and analytics tools
jobs.educationLevel: Bachelor's in Business, Computer Science, or related

jobs.title: Mobile Developer - React Native / Flutter
jobs.shortDescription: Build exceptional cross-platform mobile experiences in our React Native and Flutter codebases.
jobs.fullDescription:
Responsibilities:
- Architect and develop features in React Native and Flutter codebases
- Optimise performance on both iOS and Android
- Integrate native SDKs and maintain high code quality

Requirements:
- 2+ years building production mobile apps with React Native or Flutter
- Strong knowledge of iOS and Android platform guidelines
- Experience integrating third-party SDKs (payments, maps, analytics)
